description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations related to the Node module, including access control, search result modifications, link alterations, and ranking mechanisms.

methods.name: hook_node_grants
methods.description: Determines user grants for node access based on permissions and user ID.

methods.name: hook_node_access_records
methods.description: Sets access permissions for a node, especially for private and owner-based access.

methods.name: hook_node_access_records_alter
methods.description: Modifies node access grants before they are stored, e.g., for preview mode.

methods.name: hook_node_grants_alter
methods.description: Adjusts user grants for node operations based on roles and restrictions.

methods.name: hook_node_search_result
methods.description: Adds custom display info (like rating) to search results for nodes.

methods.name: hook_node_update_index
methods.description: Provides additional content to index for search, such as ratings.

methods.name: hook_ranking
methods.description: Defines custom ranking mechanisms for search results, e.g., based on votes.

methods.name: hook_node_search_ranking
methods.description: Provides ranking data for nodes to influence search result order.

methods.name: hook_node_links_alter
methods.description: Modifies the links associated with a node, e.g., adding a report link.
